newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Liberty Intl Money Funds AAAm.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Liberty Intl Money Funds AAAm.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday, it assigned its AAAm rating to both the sterling and US dollar share classes of Liberty International Money Funds Limited.
"The rating signifies that the funds have a superior ability to limit exposure to principal loss and maintain a constant or rising per share net asset value at all times," S&P said in a statement.
"The rating is based on the high credit quality of the holdings, minimal exposure to fluctuating interest rates and management's conservative investment policies and strategies," S&P said.
S&P reviewes portfolio composition reports on a weekly basis.
"These reports provide current information on the holdings of each class, weighted average portfolio maturities, net asset values, and investor subscriptions and redemptions," the agency said.
S&P said the two funds were denominated in their respective base currencies and were not exposed to currency risk.

"The investment objective is to achieve a competitive money market rate of return combined with minimal risk. The manager endeavors to achieve this through investment in highly liquid cash or near cash investments with maturity or interest fixing date of less than one year," the agency said.

"Investments are primarily made in institutional debt securities comprising bank deposits, certificates of deposits, bank acceptances, commercial paper, bonds and other debt instruments together with repurchase agreements, sale and buy- back agreements and securities lending."

S&P said the weighted average portfolio maturity was typically kept under 60 days, which helped to ensure liquidity and principal preservation in case of large redemptions and interest rate fluctuations.
"All investments carry short-term ratings of A1 or better, or are deemed equivalent by Standard & Poor's in order to qualify as fund investments," the agency said.

The ultimate parent company, Liberty Life Association of Africa Limited is the fourth largest company listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange with a market capitalization of approximately US$6 billion, and funds under management in excess of US$23 billion, S&P said.
